documents.title: Marion County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 42 pages. Amounts are the 2026 Department Final Budget Summary (pp. 6–9): Personal Services, Supplies, Other Charges, Capital Outlay, Debt Service, Transfers Out, Total for each fund-department; '**' rows give fund totals column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
